objective: Find a cheap online signal that detects the opened pastry VQAScore failure without computing a shadow full-DiT output at skipped steps.

rejected_signal.name: 4x4 anchor prediction-residual energy
rejected_signal.result: Rejected. Regional level, slope, and acceleration did not separate the sole VQAScore failure from passing requests, and numerical teacher residual did not reliably rank causal regional VQAScore repair gain.

candidate_signal.name: 4x4 shallow modulation positive acceleration
candidate_signal.probe_path: x_embedder -> timestep/pooled-text embedding -> transformer block-0 norm1
candidate_signal.request_risk: max over eligible skipped steps and all 16 regions of a_r(t)
candidate_signal.control_semantics: any-region veto; a majority or rank vote is not supported by the evidence

opened_request_audit.qualification: Exploratory only: this is an opened audit with one positive and multiple inspected features. The AUC is a ranking diagnostic, not a confidence-qualified serving guarantee.

dynamic_veto_intervention.threshold_status: selected on the opened failure; not qualified

decision.reason: The signal cheaply separates and causally repairs the opened VQA failure, but one positive cannot establish a threshold or false-brake rate. Oil must require a lower, independently frozen all-clear threshold and consecutive clear observations.
decision.next_action: Freeze the signal definition, collect additional independent VQAScore failures plus a new registered passing holdout, then choose separate brake and oil thresholds without reopening this audit.
